info.title: ATS Jobs API: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee
info.description:
Open roles from five applicant tracking systems in one call: title, company, location, department, remote flag, posted date and apply link.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/ats-jobs-greenhouse-lever-ashby (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Returns live job postings from company career pages on five applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee) in one dataset: title, company, department, location, employment type, remote flag, posting date and job link. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

sources.title: ATS sources
sources.description: Which Applicant Tracking Systems to pull jobs from.

greenhouseCompanies.title: Greenhouse companies
greenhouseCompanies.description: Greenhouse board tokens (company slugs). Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

leverCompanies.title: Lever companies
leverCompanies.description: Lever company slugs. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

ashbyCompanies.title: Ashby companies
ashbyCompanies.description: Ashby job-board names. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

smartrecruitersCompanies.title: SmartRecruiters companies
smartrecruitersCompanies.description: SmartRecruiters company identifiers (case-sensitive). Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

recruiteeCompanies.title: Recruitee companies
recruiteeCompanies.description: Recruitee company subdomains. Leave as-is to use a curated default list.

keywords.title: Keyword filter
keywords.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains any of these keywords (case-insensitive). Leave empty for all.

location.title: Location filter
location.description: Only keep jobs whose location contains this text (e.g. 'Berlin', 'New York', 'United States').

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: Include the full job description text (larger output).

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
